current_bottleneck: The remaining 392a failures are not solved by separable marginal quantiles or by oracle constant path-level centering. The bottleneck is horizon/cell/regime interval allocation under a valid path law, not just center/location.
last_result_summary: 493a ran an oracle constant logit-level shift per validation window/cell across the whole 30-day future. It improved level KS from 12/25 to 22/25 and preserved daily KS at 25/25, but still scored only 7/10 ex-conditionality: coverage and regime_coverage remained failed, regime layer2 stayed 0/8, and mean-reversion active pass rate fell from 83.3% to 45.8%.
next_step_recommendation: Do not implement a learned constant-shift adapter. Decide a clean next paradigm: optimize the 392a-style path law itself with coverage/level-occupancy-aware proper scores, or close the 392a repair family if that objective cannot be stated without evaluator-specific knobs.
